command:
set -eo pipefail
cd /tmp
echo '== HaplotypeCaller, the whole of chr20, NA12878 at 36x =='
# --native-pair-hmm-threads is pinned to 1 because on AArch64 it is inert: the Intel GKL
# native .so is x86-64 only, so the Java PairHMM runs single-threaded whatever you pass.
# Measured on a 2 Mb slice: 77 s at 1 thread, 78 s at 8, identical 4093 variants.
T0=$(date +%s)
gatk HaplotypeCaller -R chr20.fa -I NA12878.chr20.30x.bam -L chr20 --native-pair-hmm-threads 1 -O gatk.vcf.gz > hc.log 2>&1
T1=$(date +%s)
WALL=$(( T1 - T0 ))
zcat gatk.vcf.gz > gatk.vcf
TOTAL=$(grep -vc '^#' gatk.vcf || true)
SNV=$(awk '!/^#/ && length($4)==1 && length($5)==1' gatk.vcf | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
NONCHR20=$(awk '!/^#/ && $1!="chr20"' gatk.vcf | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
SAMPLE=$(awk '/^#CHROM/{print NF-9; exit}' gatk.vcf)
SM=$(awk '/^#CHROM/{print $10; exit}' gatk.vcf)
GKL=$(grep -c 'LOGLESS_CACHING' hc.log || true)
HASTBI=0; [ -s gatk.vcf.gz.tbi ] && HASTBI=1
{
  echo "wall_s             $WALL  (HaplotypeCaller only, boot and staging excluded)"
  echo "variants_total     $TOTAL"
  echo "snv_count          $SNV"
  echo "sample             $SM  want NA12878"
  echo "all_on_chr20       $NONCHR20  want 0"
  echo "sample_column      $SAMPLE  want 1"
  echo "vcf_index          $HASTBI  want 1 (the concordance task needs it)"
  echo "arm64_java_pairhmm $GKL  want >=1 (Intel GKL AVX .so cannot load on AArch64 -> Java LOGLESS_CACHING)"
  echo ""
  echo "The correctness bar for this recipe is NOT the count above -- it is the precision/recall"
  echo "against the GIAB HG001 v4.2.1 truth set, asserted in task 2. These are structural checks:"
  echo "a VCF that is single-sample, entirely on chr20, indexed, and produced by a genuinely"
  echo "AArch64 GATK."
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt
test "$NONCHR20" -eq 0
test "$SAMPLE" -eq 1
test "$SM" = 'NA12878'
test "$HASTBI" -eq 1
test "$GKL" -ge 1
test "$TOTAL" -gt 50000
rm -f gatk.vcf
echo 'SMOKE CHECK PASSED'
